verdict.rationale: Luma documents an API with Python/JS/TS SDKs, a docs site, markdown versions of pages, and an llms.txt, but nothing in the evidence describes an interactive API reference, a try-it console, or runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is also no machine-readable spec that could back an interactive explorer. Static docs and AI-friendly markdown are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.
